description: He asks from the idea sheet of Enclitics, the lesson whose worked example is μου in 1 John 2:1, why μου has no accent: the answer is from the lesson (μου is an enclitic, it leans on the word before it, τεκνία) and does not treat the screen as a verse.

facts.label: What it is
facts.value: An enclitic is a small word with no stress of its own: it leans on the word before it and is said with it, almost as one word, as English “him” leans on “saw” in “I saw him”.

facts.label: Steps shown
facts.value: 1. μου has no accent: it is an enclitic. 2. It leans on the word before it, τεκνία, and is said with it: τεκνία μου. 3. τεκνία μου: “my little children”.
